import numpy as np
L=np.log(P)
# test P*(a + b L)*(1 - c P) style via nonlinear grid on A, K for ln form
best=None
for A in np.linspace(0.3,1.2,91):
  for K in np.linspace(4,12,161):
    g=P*(1-P/K)*np.log(P/A)
    s=np.dot(g,dP_dt)/np.dot(g,g)
    e=np.mean((dP_dt-s*g)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,A,K,s)
print(best)
